title: Air travel
subtitle: check-in desk, boarding card, take off, baggage reclaim
summary: Use the right words for every stage of a flight, from the check-in desk to baggage reclaim and customs.

lesson.heading: At the airport
lesson.text: When you arrive at an airport, the **departures board** shows the **flight numbers**, the **departure times** and the **destinations** (where the flights are going to). You then go to the **check-in desk**.

examples.text: The **departures board** shows the **departure time** of every flight.

lesson.heading: Check-in and departure
lesson.text: At **check-in** someone checks your ticket and **weighs** your **luggage**. If it is too heavy, you pay **excess baggage**. You get your **boarding card**, go through **passport control**, and wait in the **departure lounge**.

examples.text: You can take your **hand luggage** with you on the **aircraft**.
You will have to pay **excess baggage**.
You can buy perfume in the **duty-free shop**.

lesson.heading: On the plane
lesson.text: When you **board** the plane (get on it), you put your hand luggage in the **overhead locker** above your seat. Then you **fasten your seat belt**. If there are no **delays**, the plane moves to the **runway** and **takes off**.

examples.text: Please put your bag in the **overhead locker**.
We all had to **fasten** our seat belts.
There was a one-hour **delay** because of bad weather.
examples.note: a delay = when you wait longer than expected

examples.text: The plane moves slowly to the **runway**, then it **takes off**.

lesson.heading: Arrival
lesson.text: When the plane **lands**, there is an **announcement** from a member of the **cabin crew**. Then you **get off** the plane and walk through the **terminal building** to passport control.

examples.text: It was raining when we **landed** in Rome.
There was an **announcement** about the delay.
examples.note: = spoken information to a group of people
= the people who look after the passengers

examples.text: You collect your bags at **baggage reclaim** and then go through **customs**.

lesson.heading: Places at the airport
rows: staff check your ticket and weigh your luggage
you wait and buy things in the duty-free shop
the plane takes off and lands
the airport building you walk through
your luggage may be checked for illegal things

lesson.text: *fly* is the verb; the noun is *flight*. Say a long flight and my flight number, never ~~a long fly~~.

exercises.prompt: Match the two halves to make a word or phrase.
Match each airport word with its meaning.

pairs.right: extra money you pay for heavy luggage
the place where you collect your luggage
the place where someone checks your passport
the area where your luggage may be checked

exercises.prompt: What do we call the people who travel on a plane?
exercises.explanation: Passengers travel on the plane; the cabin crew look after them.

exercises.prompt: At the check-in desk, staff weigh your ___.
exercises.explanation: Luggage is uncountable: a lot of luggage, not ~~luggages~~.

exercises.prompt: The place you are travelling to is called your ___.
exercises.explanation: The departures board shows the destinations of all the flights.

exercises.prompt: The place in the airport where you get on the plane is called the ___.
exercises.explanation: You go to Gate 3 or Gate 5 shortly before take-off.

exercises.prompt: The part of the airport where the plane takes off and lands is called the ___.
exercises.explanation: The runway is the large road that planes use for take-offs and landings.

exercises.prompt: Does each thing happen when you leave (departure) or when you arrive (arrival)?
There was an ___ telling us that there would be a one-hour delay.
exercises.hint: (spoken information to a group of people)
exercises.explanation: An announcement is spoken information given to a group of people.

exercises.prompt: The plane could not leave on time, so there was a one-hour ___ because of bad weather.
exercises.explanation: A delay is when you have to wait longer than expected.

exercises.prompt: There was bad weather over France and we all had to ___ our seat belts.
exercises.explanation: You fasten your seat belt before take-off and in bad weather.

exercises.statement: It was still raining and very windy when we landed in Rome.
exercises.explanation: Correct. A plane lands when it arrives on the ground.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the right order to describe arriving.
exercises.answer: When the plane lands, you get off and walk through the terminal building
exercises.explanation: You get off the plane and walk through the terminal building to passport control.
